payload.summary: Planning partner returned the spec for all six asks, collapsed to five PRs, with build order rail-gutter (wf7yak5w) -> tray-rhythm (03ctcktt) -> card-face-declutter (m1gajaze) -> hand-total-placement (0e9kwr0h) -> double-wager-button (xa1d7wj7). Order rationale: the rail gutter changes the felt box every other item is measured against; the tray fix is tuned against that new width; card face and hand totals are hermetic and touch disjoint CSS regions; the 2x button ships last because it is the only behavioural change, spends the tray headroom, and renumbers tabIndex across three files. Asks 2 and 3 ship as ONE PR (a button with no behaviour is not reviewable); everything else stays separate so a spacing complaint stays bisectable. Planner corrected three of my briefing claims: the 1239px media block does NOT override table padding (the 859px one overrides grid-template-rows); the tray is not cosmetic but a broken control (the action cluster overflows its 240px track by 40px at 1440 and 118px at 1200, putting Clear under a chip and then off-felt); and the banker total badge covers the banker FIRST card at every width, not just third-card rounds.
